initial_run: XR2, Skateboard GB 2024, seed 1010; one recording only until labels evaluated
sequence: 3 calibration holds at indices 0/5/10; 8 randomised linear gestures with constant speed; separate requests at host slots 1,6,12,18,24,30,36,42,48,54,57 seconds; no device checks in loop
primary: Using WDA submitted_to_ios.monotonic_s, fit video = first_label + (submit-first_submit)*(last_label-first_label)/(last_submit-first_submit). Only first and last calibration labels used for fit.
evaluation: All 8 gestures and middle calibration held out; every absolute residual <=1/30 second required. Report each error, max and mean absolute error; no refitting/exclusions. Require first-to-last anchor span >=55 seconds for minute-scale admission.
followup_gate: Only after initial pass: same three parks on XR1/XR2, one recording per pair, initial included. No separate-day criterion. One annotator at a time.
excluded: No collection integration, WDA promotion, or new training data in this plan
